item.title: Upgrading
item.description:
Most releases ask nothing: a workload picks up a new library with its own next render. This page carries the ones that need a decision first.

kurly cuts a release on every push, with a calendar version that carries the time of day (library-2026.8.3141650), so an entry is dated rather than numbered and applies from the first release of that day onward.

2026-11-25 — filebrowser, metamcp, whoogle and yt-dlp-web-ui removed

The upstream repositories of these four workloads are archived, so the catalogue no longer carries them. File Browser’s maintainers have announced no further releases or security fixes, and Whoogle can no longer fetch search results at all. catalog/excluded.libsonnet records the reason for each.
